# Publish the change

Given Task, Repository, project instructions, Plan, Changes, PR context, and passing Test evidence for the current changes, review the diff and publish the code using the project's branch and commit conventions.

Create a pull request describing the change and focused test results, or update the existing PR from PR context. Check an uncertain publication result before retrying to avoid duplicate PRs. Return the confirmed PR URL. Do not wait for CI or merge the PR.
